scope: CP40 private occasions, separate circle date sharing and suggestion permission, yearly suggestion state and revocable candidate origins; schema7

environment.fixtures: Generated isolated local databases; fixed date clock only for calendar boundaries; no user database or original photos

history.breakdown: 12 API cases and 11 independent date cases

history.failure: An added test incorrectly assumed 30 travelers exceed every plan capacity. The real public shore plan supports 30-60 and was correctly returned. The fixture was corrected to 100 travelers; no application source change was needed.
history.existing_suite_result: All 80 pre-CP40 tests and all 11 independent date tests passed in this run.

history.note: Final targeted rerun after correcting the fixture; no claim of a single 103-pass run.

verified: Private defaults, one birthday per person with no birth year, multiple named occasions, own CRUD and optimistic versions
Invalid calendar dates and one-time dates without a year rejected
Date-only sharing works without enabling suggestions; private preview remains owner-only and uses independent normal candidate saving
Authentication, nonmember and provider access checks; own event IDs cannot be used to read another person's private preview or delete their occasion
Stable occurrence identity by event/circle/year, per-user later/dismissed states, stale versions and past occurrences rejected
JST calendar, inclusive 30-day window, year rollover and February 29 normalization; original stored month/day retained
Current owner grant and circle tags re-rank suggestions; other viewers do not receive private interest reasons
Confirmed people, date and provider schedule changes exclude unsuitable plans; stale plan versions rejected
Candidate save is idempotent and creates no provider invitation; snapshots contain public plan fields only
Revocation, deletion and date edits hide origin-only cards; re-permission alone cannot revive prior origin permissions
Multiple origins preserve the card until all relevant origins expire; independent saves before or after occasion saves survive occasion deletion
Owner community exit latches sharing off across rejoin; viewer membership removal denies reading and changing suggestion state
Passing the occurrence date removes near-date suggestions but retains authorized saved cards; plan unpublishing is shown as unavailable
Concurrent duplicate saves produce one card; reopening preserves candidate snapshots and per-user suggestion state
Schema6 nonempty journal, party, candidate and reflection rows preserved by additive schema7; failed migration rolls back all new tables

review.status: No major static findings before build
clarifications: Added a date-only shared listing independent of suggestion permission
Saved origins remain valid after the near-date window; current ended/unpublished plan state is still shown

limitations: Docker migration against existing saved data, browser integration and deployment restart are parent-agent validations recorded separately.
No external notifications, AI calls, bookings, availability claims or invented anniversary benefits were implemented.
Runtime image model and unrelated full-suite ONNX validation are outside this targeted API regression.
A saved candidate is a planning suggestion, not an actual visit, provider acceptance or reservation.
